39403-historic-fredericksburg-the-story-.title: _Printed In U.S.A._
39403-historic-fredericksburg-the-story-.creator: Whittet & Shepperson Richmond Va.
39403-historic-fredericksburg-the-story-.description: A book by Whittet & Shepperson Richmond Va.. Fredericksburg sprawls at the foot of the hills where the scented summer winds sweep over it out of the valley of brawling waters above. The grass grows lush in the meadows and tangles in the hills that almost surround it.

63199-stories-pictures-tell-book-6.title: Book Six
63199-stories-pictures-tell-book-6.creator: Flora L. Carpenter
63199-stories-pictures-tell-book-6.description: A book by Flora L. Carpenter. =Questions to arouse interest.= Who is this man? What do his armor and title “Sir” tell us he is? How many have read Tennyson’s poems telling the story of the knights of the Round Table? What does Sir Galahad look as if he were about to do? Why do you think he is starting on a journey, rather than returning from one? Why do you think it must be an important journey? What was expected of a knight in those days?

71352-the-crimson-banner.title: A Story of College Baseball
71352-the-crimson-banner.creator: William D. Moffat
71352-the-crimson-banner.description: A book by William D. Moffat. ons were landmarks of the college, and dear to the heart of every inmate. Many years before they had been discovered by a rambling party of students in a deserted part of the hilly country about ten miles west of Belmont. It was believed that they had been left there by a section of the army during the war of 1812.

arxiv-2012-06554.title: TEEMon : A continuous performance monitoring framework for TEEs
arxiv-2012-06554.creator: Robert Krahn, Donald Dragoti, Franz Gregor, Do Le Quoc, Valerio Schiavoni, Pascal Felber, Clenimar Souza, Andrey Brito, Christof Fetzer
arxiv-2012-06554.description: Abstract . Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), such as Intel Software Guard eXtensions (SGX), are considered as a promising approach to resolve security challenges in clouds. TEEs protect the confidentiality and integrity of application code and data even against privileged attackers with root and physical access by providing an isolated secure memory area, i . e .,, enclaves .

arxiv-2205-08406.description: Abstract Radar is an inevitable part of the perception sensor set for autonomous driving functions. It plays a gap-filling role to complement the shortcomings of other sensors in diverse scenarios and weather conditions. In this paper, we propose a Deep Neural Network (DNN) based end-to-end object detection and heading estimation framework using raw radar data.

arxiv-2207-01645.creator: Lara Alegre, Jose Sabater, Philip Best, Rafaël I.J. Mostert, Wendy L. Williams, Gülay Gürkan, Martin J. Hardcastle, Rohit Kondapally, Tim W. Shimwell, Daniel J.B. Smith
arxiv-2207-01645.description: Abstract New-generation radio telescopes like LOFAR are conducting extensive sky surveys, detecting millions of sources. To maximise the scientific value of these surveys, radio source components must be properly associated into physical sources before being cross-matched with their optical/infrared counterparts.

arxiv-2302-08390.title: Photonic Neural Networks: A Compact Review
arxiv-2302-08390.creator: Mohammad Ahmadi, Hamidreza Bolhasani
arxiv-2302-08390.description: Abstract Abstract It has long been known that photonic science and especially photonic communications can raise the speed of technologies and manufacturing. More recently, photonic science has also been interested in its capabilities to implement low-precision linear operations, such as matrix multiplications, quickly and efficiently.

arxiv-2304-00213.title: Human-Robot Interaction in Retinal Surgery: A Comparative Study of Serial and Parallel Cooperative Robots
arxiv-2304-00213.creator: Botao Zhao, Mojtaba Esfandiari, David E. Usevitch, Student Member, IEEE, Peter Gehlbach, Member, IEEE, Iulian Iordachita, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2304-00213.description: Abstract Cooperative robots for intraocular surgery allow surgeons to perform vitreoretinal surgery with high precision and stability. Several robot structural designs have shown capabilities to perform these surgeries. This research investigates the comparative performance of a serial and parallel cooperative-controlled robot in completing a retinal vessel-following task, with a focus on human-robot interaction performance and user experience.

arxiv-2505-18682.title: Integrating Region-Specific SARS-CoV-2 Data for Statistical Wastewater Monitoring
arxiv-2505-18682.description: Abstract Wastewater data can be very useful for epidemic control during a disease outbreak and proper synthesis of different sources of information can be integrated towards an alerting system, that can be used for decision support. Wastewater data are considered to be of high quality, since they do not depend on testing and can take into account asymptomatic cases.

arxiv-2508-09292.title: The Othello AI Arena: Evaluating Intelligent Systems Through Limited-Time Adaptation to Unseen Boards
arxiv-2508-09292.creator: Sundong Kim
arxiv-2508-09292.description: Abstract The ability to rapidly adapt to novel and unforeseen environmental changes is a cornerstone of artificial general intelligence (AGI), yet it remains a critical blind spot in most existing AI benchmarks. Traditional evaluation largely focuses on optimizing performance within fixed environments, failing to assess systems’ flexibility and generalization capabilities when faced with even subtle rule or structural modifications.

europmc-pmc6946671.creator: Nie H, Ju H, Fan J, Shi X, Cheng Y, Cang X, Zheng Z, Duan X, Yi W.
europmc-pmc6946671.description: Many cancer cells display enhanced glycolysis and suppressed mitochondrial metabolism. This phenomenon, known as the Warburg effect, is critical for tumor development. However, how cancer cells coordinate glucose metabolism through glycolysis and the mitochondrial tricarboxylic...

pmc-10539709.title: Precise Orchestration of Gasdermins' Pore-Forming Function by Posttranslational Modifications in Health and Disease
pmc-10539709.creator: Haiyang Jiang, Peizhao Liu, Jiaqi Kang, Jie Wu, Wenbin Gong, Xuanheng Li, Yangguang Li, Juanhan Liu, Weizhen Li, Chujun Ni, Bo Liao, Xiuwen Wu, Yun Zhao, Jianan Ren
pmc-10539709.description: Gasdermins (GSDMs) serve as pivotal executors of pyroptosis and play crucial roles in host defence, cytokine secretion, innate immunity, and cancer. However, excessive or inappropriate GSDMs activation is invariably accompanied by exaggerated inflammation and results in tissue damage. In contrast, deficient or impaired activation of GSDMs often fails to promptly eliminate pathogens, leading to the increasing severity of infections.

pmc-10650172.title: Flow Sorting, Whole Genome Amplification and Next-Generation Sequencing as Combined Tools to Study Heterogeneous Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
pmc-10650172.creator: Rabiah Fardoos, Claus Christensen, Nina Friesgaard Øbro, Ulrik Malthe Overgaard, Bodil Als-Nielsen, Hans Ole Madsen, Hanne Vibeke Marquart
pmc-10650172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Next-generation sequencing (NGS) methods have been introduced for immunoglobulin (IG)/T-cell receptor (TR) gene rearrangement analysis in acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and lymphoma (LBL). These methods likely constitute faster and more sensitive approaches to analyze heterogenous cases of ALL/LBL, yet it is not known whether gene rearrangements constituting low percentages of the total sequence reads represent minor subpopulations of malignant cells or background IG/TR gene rearrangements in normal B-and T-cells.

pmc-11375544.title: Association of MTHFR gene polymorphisms with non-Hodgkin lymphoma risk: Evidence from 31 articles
pmc-11375544.creator: Gang Wang, Yuluo Wu, Zuolei Jing, Ruiting Wen, Yuanrui Song, Yin Feng, Guangru Li, Xiaopeng Zou, Gaoxiang Huang, Zhirong Jia, Yunmiao Guo, Zhigang Yang
pmc-11375544.description: Background: Methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) gene polymorphisms, particularly C677T and A1298C, have been implicated in various cancers, including non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL); however, their association with NHL risk remains inconclusive.Methods: We conducted an updated meta-analysis to assess the relationship between MTHFR gene polymorphisms (C677T and A1298C) and NHL risk. Relevant studies were identified through systematic literature searches in multiple databases.

pmc-11507510.title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Immunotherapy: Predictors of Response, Issues, and Challenges
pmc-11507510.creator: Alessandro Rizzo, Oronzo Brunetti, Giovanni Brandi, Nam Deuk Kim, Victor van Beusechem
pmc-11507510.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), such as durvalumab, tremelimumab, and atezolizumab, have emerged as a significant therapeutic option for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). In fact, the efficacy of ICIs as single agents or as part of combination therapies has been demonstrated in practice-changing phase III clinical trials.

pmc-11642839.title: Thraustochytrids: Evolution, Ultrastructure, Biotechnology, and Modeling
pmc-11642839.creator: Aleksei G Menzorov, Daniil A Iukhtanov, Ludmila G Naumenko, Aleksandr V Bobrovskikh, Ulyana S Zubairova, Ksenia N Morozova, Alexey V Doroshkov, Mariusz Cycoń
pmc-11642839.description: The thraustochytrids are a group of marine protists known for their significant ecological roles as decomposers and parasites as well as for their potential biotechnological applications, yet their evolutionary and structural diversity remains poorly understood. Our review critically examines the phylogeny of this taxa, utilizing available up-to-date knowledge and their taxonomic classifications.

pmc-11647568.title: JTH in Clinic: management of low-risk pulmonary embolism
pmc-11647568.creator: Henry Han, Connor O’Hare, Elizabeth Joyce, Jeffrey A. Kline, Colin F. Greineder, Geoffrey D. Barnes
pmc-11647568.description: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a common cardiovascular disease diagnosis in emergency departments that can be associated with significant morbidity and mortality. One of the first steps after diagnosing PE is to risk stratify for adverse outcomes using risk scores such as PE Severity Index and European Society of Cardiology risk scheme.

pmc-11843580.title: Sequencing whole genomes of the West Javanese population in Indonesia reveals novel variants and improves imputation accuracy
pmc-11843580.creator: Edwin Ardiansyah, Anca-Lelia Riza, Sofiati Dian, Ahmad Rizal Ganiem, Bachti Alisjahbana, Todia P. Setiabudiawan, Arjan van Laarhoven, Reinout van Crevel, Vinod Kumar
pmc-11843580.description: Existing genotype imputation reference panels are mainly derived from European populations, limiting their accuracy in non-European populations. To improve imputation accuracy for Indonesians, the world’s fourth most populous country, we combined Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) data from 227 West Javanese individuals with East Asian data from the 1,000 Genomes Project.

pmc-12551266.title: Medical student coaching in the U.S.: a national survey of clinical skills educators
pmc-12551266.creator: Delphine Taylor, Katherine Anderson, Shubha Dathatri, Jean E Klig, Henry Park, Megan Fix
pmc-12551266.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCoaching is increasingly recognized as a valuable tool to amplify learning in undergraduate medical education (UME), yet national data on its implementation, particularly in the context of clinical skills education, remain limited. Previous survey studies on coaching in medical education have focused on select institutions with established coaching programs, leaving a gap in understanding the broader landscape of coaching in UME. This study aims to address three critical gaps: current descriptions of coaching programs across U.S.

pmc-12564240.title: Outcomes of Transobturator Tape Surgery for Stress and Mixed Urinary Incontinence: A 12-Year Retrospective Review
pmc-12564240.creator: Cheng-Feng Lin, Hung-Yi Chen, Chun-Te Wu, Kuan-Lin Liu, Cheng-Chia Lin, Heng-Jung Hsu, Chin-Chan Lee, Chun-Yu Chen
pmc-12564240.description: Background: Stress urinary incontinence (SUI) and mixed urinary incontinence (MUI) are common disorders that impair quality of life. While transobturator tension-free vaginal tape (TVT-O) is established for SUI, outcomes in MUI remain uncertain. Methods: We analyzed 111 women who underwent TVT-O at Keelung Chang Gung Memorial Hospital.

pmc-12675957.title: Early-Onset Degenerative Bone Changes as a Manifestation of Alkaptonuria: A Case Report
pmc-12675957.creator: Rui Braga, Fábia Teixeira, Cátia Matos
pmc-12675957.description: Alkaptonuria is a rare inherited metabolic disorder characterized by progressive pigment deposition in connective tissues, leading to early degenerative joint disease and tendon fragility. Although uncommon, its clinical manifestations may closely resemble more prevalent musculoskeletal conditions, often resulting in delayed diagnosis.

pmc-12738535.title: Evaluation of dental ages of children with type I diabetes using different dental age estimation methods: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12738535.creator: Deniz Sıla Özdemir Çelik, Melek Belevcikli
pmc-12738535.description: Type 1 diabetes may affect skeletal and dental development, but its influence on dental age estimation remains unclear. The aim of this study was to determine the estimated dental age of children with type 1 diabetes by using Cameriere, Willems and Demirjian methods.

pmc-13475873.title: Navigating complexity: Evaluating management measures for multispecies snapper-grouper fisheries in the Southeast U.S. Atlantic
pmc-13475873.creator: Jie Cao, Kyle Shertzer, Scott Crosson, Erik Williams, Rick DeVictor, Abdul Azeez Pokkathappada, Abdul Azeez Pokkathappada, Abdul Azeez Pokkathappada, Abdul Azeez Pokkathappada
pmc-13475873.description: Multispecies fisheries are globally common, but typically managed through single-species controls. This situation can result in wasteful discarding, when fish of some species cannot be retained, but fishing effort toward the complex continues. In contrast, managing multispecies fisheries through effort controls can address this shortcoming.

pmc-13500351.title: Non-cigarette tobacco cessation support in England: current provision, confidence, and barriers identified in a cross-sectional survey of healthcare professionals involved in smoking cessation support
pmc-13500351.creator: Yo Seop Byun, Eve Taylor, Lion Shahab, Katherine East, Jamie Brown, Harry Tattan-Birch, Sharon Cox, Masuma Pervin Mishu, David Hammond, Sarah E Jackson

pmc-13508720.title: Operation Limits of Integrated Photo‐Rechargeable Batteries
pmc-13508720.creator: Byung‐Man Kim, Arvind Pujari, Hooman Abbasi, Weidong Xu, Yutong Han, Samuel D. Stranks, Michael De Volder
pmc-13508720.description: Monolithic photo‐rechargeable batteries (PRB) are attractive solution for powering off‐grid autonomous systems. However, the fundamental effects limiting the light‐charging process in such devices are not well understood. Herein, we present an integrated PRB design that can be fully charged under a range of illuminances.

pmc-13572750.title: Partner presence, social support and chronic pain recovery: reply to a Letter to the Editor
pmc-13572750.creator: Camila C. Castro, Sandro Max C. Silva, Martha M.C. Castro, Durval Campos Kraychete, Carla Daltro
pmc-13572750.description: he interpretation of the association between partner presence and clinically meaningful pain improvement observed in our cohort.2 Partner presence should not be interpreted as a direct measure of social support. In our study, marital status was collected as a sociodemographic variable and included in the multivariable model because of its potential association with clinical outcomes.

uslaw-usc-t15-s9054.title: 15 U.S.C. § 9054 — Conflicts of interest
uslaw-usc-t15-s9054.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s9054.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 116 (Coronavirus Economic Stabilization (Cares Act)); Subchapter III (Economic Stabilization And Assistance To Severely Distressed Sectors Of The United States Economy); Part A (Coronavirus Economic Stabilization). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Controlling interest The term “controlling interest” means owning, controlling, or holding not less than 20 percent.
